servers.name: asr_speakers
servers.cmd: uv run --locked --project spikes/audio python -m mlx_audio.server --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8102 --log-dir <log dir>/logs

servers.name: tts_speakers
servers.cmd: uv run --locked --project spikes/audio python -m mlx_audio.server --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8103 --log-dir <log dir>/logs

conditions.note: dylan and eric are left out: with lang_code chinese/auto, mlx-audio switches them to their dialect language id (beijing_dialect / sichuan_dialect)
